StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description: Represents an Admin (OWNER, unlimited count via secret code DXPPOST) or Delivery Driver (DRIVER) in DXP POST.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user or admin who created the profile.

companyCode.description: Company workspace identifier for DXP POST.

name.description: Full display name of the admin or driver.

email.description: Google account email address of the admin or driver.

role.description: Role within DXP POST: OWNER (Admin, unlimited) or DRIVER (Delivery driver).

adminCode.description: Optional special admin authorization code (DXPPOST) used to unlock OWNER role.

vehicleInfo.description: Vehicle type, plate number, or assigned delivery zone.

active.description: Whether the staff member is currently active.

DeliveryOrder.title: DeliveryOrder
DeliveryOrder.description: Represents a commercial package delivery order (wasl) in DXP POST, created by either a Driver or an Admin.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the driver or admin who created the order.

companyCode.description: Company workspace identifier for DXP POST.

senderPhone.description: Phone number of the person/sender who sent the package.

customerPhone.description: Phone number of the recipient customer receiving the package.

packageImageBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG Base64 image of the package.

itemPriceIqd.description: Price of the package goods in Iraqi Dinars (IQD).

totalAmountIqd.description: Total amount to collect from customer (itemPriceIqd + deliveryFeeIqd).

returnReason.description: Reason if the package was returned or postponed.

assignedDriverId.description: Firebase Auth UID / Staff ID of the assigned driver.

assignedDriverName.description: Display name of the assigned driver.

isSettled.description: Whether the cash collected for this order has been settled with an admin.

CashSettlement.title: CashSettlement
CashSettlement.description: Represents an accounting cash settlement receipt between a driver and an admin.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who recorded the settlement.

companyCode.description: Company workspace identifier for DXP POST.

driverId.description: Staff ID / UID of the driver whose cash was settled.

ordersCount.description: Number of delivered orders settled in this transaction.

itemPriceTotalIqd.description: Total merchant goods price settled in IQD.

deliveryFeeTotalIqd.description: Total delivery fee settled in IQD.

totalSettledCashIqd.description: Total cash handed over by the driver in IQD (itemPriceTotalIqd + deliveryFeeTotalIqd).

/staff/{staffId}.description: Collection of DXP POST staff members (unlimited admins via code DXPPOST and delivery drivers).

/orders/{orderId}.description: Collection of DXP POST delivery orders synchronized in real time.

/settlements/{settlementId}.description: Collection of DXP POST cash and accounting settlement records.
